configurations.name: api-test-once
runtimeArgs: cd /home/neo/Projects/Possibility/api && npx vitest run > /tmp/vitest-final.txt 2>&1; echo EXIT=$? >> /tmp/vitest-final.txt; sleep 2

configurations.name: drizzle-migrate-once
runtimeArgs: cd /home/neo/Projects/Possibility/api && npx drizzle-kit generate >> /tmp/migrate-out.txt 2>&1 && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local >> /tmp/migrate-out.txt 2>&1; echo EXIT=$? >> /tmp/migrate-out.txt; sleep 2

configurations.name: tsc-once
runtimeArgs: cd /home/neo/Projects/Possibility/api && npx tsc --noEmit > /tmp/tsc-out.txt 2>&1; echo API_EXIT=$? >> /tmp/tsc-out.txt; cd ../web && npx tsc --noEmit >> /tmp/tsc-out.txt 2>&1; echo WEB_EXIT=$? >> /tmp/tsc-out.txt; sleep 2
